$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor validation.

$manifestVersion.description: Schema version. Enables future format evolution.

id.description: Unique pack identifier. Lowercase, alphanumeric with hyphens.

builtIn.description: Whether this pack is bundled with the host app.

description.description: Short description of the pack's purpose.

hostVersion.description: Semver range for compatible host versions (e.g. ">=0.3.0").

dependencies.description: Other packs this pack depends on. Keys are pack IDs, values are semver ranges or file/URL references.

permissions.description: Capabilities this pack requires from the host.

entities.description: EARS entity types this pack registers. Keys are enum names, values are string identifiers.

relKinds.description: EARS relation kinds this pack registers. Keys are enum names, values are string identifiers.

excludedEntityTypes.description: Entity types excluded from persistence (in-memory only).

secretEntityTypes.description: Entity types routed to the secrets store.

partitionPolicy.description: Built-in packs only. Ignored for external packs.

source.description: Source file path relative to pack root.

type.description: Exported TypeScript type name for the entity attributes.

entityShapes.description: Maps entity type strings to their TypeScript attribute interfaces for type-safe EARS queries.

designation.description: Links the system to an EARS designation.

typesEntry.description: Additional types to include in the generated type barrel.

earlySystem.description: Built-in packs only. Ignored for external packs.

entry.description: Path to the backend system module.

outgoingEventsType.description: TypeScript type name for outgoing events (used by codegen).

incoming.description: Event types this system listens for.

entry.description: Path to the frontend plugin module.

label.description: Display name shown in the sidebar.

icon.description: Icon name from the icon library.

isPinned.description: Whether this plugin is pinned in the sidebar by default.

services.description: Service modules. Keys are service names, values are source file paths.

contributions.description: Built-in packs only. Ignored for external packs.

features.description: Feature definitions. Each feature bundles a backend system, frontend plugin, services, and settings.

defaultPlugin.description: ID of the feature to show by default when the app starts.

packServices.description: Pack-level services not tied to a specific feature. Keys are service names, values are source file paths.

earlySystem.description: Built-in packs only. Ignored for external packs.

createDefaultSettings.description: Module that ensures default settings exist.

entityType.description: EARS entity type for collection seeders.

lookupField.description: Field used to deduplicate seeded entities.

seed.description: Seed data sources. Keys are seed type names, values are paths or config objects.

skipAtBoot.description: Seed types to skip during boot.

skipAfterOnboarding.description: Seed types to skip after onboarding completes.

seedPolicy.description: Controls which seed types to skip at boot or after onboarding.

anyOf.description: Deprecated shorthand — use the object form with register + definitions.

register.description: Path to the step registration barrel file.

kind.description: Whether this is a regular step or a trigger.

primaryField.description: The field whose value becomes the step label in the flow editor.

defaultLabel.description: Fallback label when primaryField is empty.

custom.description: Marks the step as a custom (non-built-in) type.

artifacts.description: Path to artifact type registration module.

blocks.description: Path to message block registration module.

entry.description: Path to the frontend entry module.

tiptapPlugins.description: Path to tiptap plugin registration module.

appExtensions.description: Named app extensions. Keys are extension names, values are paths to Vue components.

styles.description: Path to a CSS file to include in the frontend bundle.

entry.description: Path to the DSL type definition module.

globals.description: Global type mappings injected into the DSL scope.

dsl.description: DSL type definitions for Monaco editor intellisense.
